formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R3 — Prospective Soft Opportunity-Matching Constitution, 2×2 Action-Opportunity Total-Variation Geometry, Radius/Kernel Common-Support Recovery, Approximation-Error Calibration, Outcome-Blind Balance Selection, Fresh↔Legacy Transport, Residual LB7 Alignment Sensitivity, Negative-Control Geometry & Partial-Identification Audit

precursor_run.note: primary structural selection and behavioral verdict were unchanged in canonical completion

selected_soft_match.interpretation: at most one unit of action mass transferred between opportunity categories

other_candidates.R2: mean approximation distance exceeds 1 action-mass unit

negative_control.construction: deterministic within-solve×progress-quintile rotation of lb labels; selected R1 family held fixed
negative_control.interpretation: specificity is partial: true-lb7 attenuation transports across both ancestries, while rotated-label attenuation appears in fresh but not legacy

interpretation: A one-action-mass TV caliper was selected without behavioral outcomes and passed the presealed approximation/support gates in both ancestries.
Under that selected family, the fresh lb7 residual nearly vanishes and reverses sign, satisfying the presealed structural-opportunity-sufficient rule.
The legacy residual is also attenuated below half of its parent magnitude, providing cross-ancestry directional support.
Solve-clustered sign-flip diagnostics are weak and are not used as promotion thresholds.
The rotated-label negative control rules out a universal shrink-to-zero artifact across ancestries, but fresh-only control attenuation prevents a claim of complete specificity.
The result therefore supports structural opportunity as a sufficient descriptive explanation under the presealed soft-matching family, not causal mediation or a cognitive mechanism.
boundary: Soft matching is approximate structural adjustment, not exact state identity.
The R1 caliper was selected before behavioral outcomes were opened.
Fresh and legacy parent estimands are not numerically identical to the target-state soft-matching estimand, so attenuation ratios are diagnostic rather than causal effect fractions.
Negative-control specificity is partial rather than definitive.
Human-contact and mechanism-promotion gates remain closed.
successor_problem: Stress whether the R1 attenuation is stable to outcome-blind perturbations of distance geometry, target aggregation, progress granularity, ancestry composition and caliper-edge inclusion, without reopening candidate selection or tuning to behavioral residuals.
